allowCleartextPasswords.description: Allows using the cleartext client side plugin if required by an account.

authenticationType.description: The authentication method used to connect to the database.

connMaxLifetime.description: Maximum lifetime of a connection in seconds. Default is 14400 (4 hours). Set to 0 to reuse connections forever.

connectionTimeout.description: The number of seconds to wait before aborting attempts to connect to the database.

enableSecureSocksProxy.description: Enables proxying the datasource connection through the secure socks proxy.

encrypt.description: Determines whether or how the connection to the server is encrypted.

maxIdleConns.description: Maximum number of idle connections in the connection pool.

maxOpenConns.description: Maximum number of open connections to the database. Default is 100.

secureSocksProxyUsername.description: Username used to authenticate with the secure socks proxy.

servername.description: Server name used to verify the hostname on the returned TLS certificate.

sslCertFile.description: Path to the client certificate file for TLS/SSL client authentication.

sslKeyFile.description: Path to the client key file for TLS/SSL client authentication.

sslRootCertFile.description: Path to the root certificate file. Required if TLS/SSL mode is verify-ca or verify-full.

sslmode.description: Determines whether or with what priority a secure TLS/SSL TCP/IP connection will be negotiated with the server.

timeInterval.description: A lower limit for the auto group by time interval. Recommended to be set to write frequency, for example 1m if your data is written every minute.

timescaledb.description: TimescaleDB is a time-series database built as a PostgreSQL extension. If enabled, Grafana will use time_bucket in the $__timeGroup macro and display TimescaleDB specific aggregate functions in the query builder.

timezone.description: Specify the timezone used in the database session, such as Europe/Berlin or +02:00.

tlsConfigurationMethod.description: How TLS/SSL certificates are configured. File system path specifies paths to certificates on the local file system. Certificate content stores certificate data encrypted in Grafana's database.

tlsSkipVerify.description: When enabled, skips verification of the PostgreSQL server's TLS certificate chain and host name.

secureValues.description: PEM-encoded root CA certificate content. Required for verify-ca and verify-full modes.
